sight:lore-explorable-home-3.name: A Field Guide to Executive Waterfowl
sight:lore-explorable-home-3.description: The dust jacket promises an indispensable companion for the modern naturalist.

sight:abandoned-factory.name: Abandoned building
sight:abandoned-factory.description: The windows are boarded up. Something inside is still on the clock.

place:ai-lab.name: AI Lab
place:ai-lab.description: A SoMa AI lab with a levitating cortical brain, magnetic containment rings, specimen pods, and humming GPU racks.

actor:ai-lab-recruiter.name: AI Lab Recruiter
actor:ai-lab-recruiter.description: A lab recruiter clutching a clipboard labeled "general intelligence." The entire interview fits in a calculator, which is strictly forbidden.

actor:airship-rental-attendant.name: Airship Attendant
actor:airship-rental-attendant.description: A punctual attendant with a brass watch and a very long retrieval cable. Their flight schedule has exactly one departure: whenever you are ready.

sight:shared-airship-rope.name: Airship Rope
sight:shared-airship-rope.description: A rope hanging from the airship basket. Climb aboard.

sight:american-industrial-center.name: American Industrial Center
sight:american-industrial-center.description: A brick-and-sawtooth workshop filled with precision tools and the sound of careful metalwork.

actor:industrial-armorer.name: Armorer
actor:industrial-armorer.description: He measures twice, sharpens once, and always checks the paperwork.

sight:personal-b2.name: B-2 Stealth Bomber
sight:personal-b2.description: Your personal flying wing, its dark fuselage disappearing into the hangar's shadows.

sight:nia.name: Bani
sight:nia.description: A friendly woman enjoying her coffee at a table inside Mazarine.

actor:shanghai-bartender.name: Bartender
actor:shanghai-bartender.description: A neighborhood bartender who can measure a pint, a coin, and the precise moment that the floor starts moving.

actor:ssf-battery-seller.name: Battery Seller
actor:ssf-battery-seller.description: A local adventurer. Currently undertaking the difficult quest called "one more errand."

sight:salt-flats.name: Bay Area Salt Flats
sight:salt-flats.description: A patchwork of pink, green, and silver evaporation ponds beside the South Bay. Salt crust rims the water; dirt levees keep your feet dry. A letter-writing desk stands beside the levee.

sight:baybridge.name: Bay Bridge
sight:baybridge.description: The bridge leaves the eastern waterfront for Yerba Buena Island and the East Bay.

sight:bayshore-pocket-garden.name: Bayshore Courtyard
sight:bayshore-pocket-garden.description: A little neighborhood garden: flowering pots, a shaded bench, and a thoroughly unmonetized view.

sight:bayshore-design-studio.name: Bayshore Design Studio
sight:bayshore-design-studio.description: A garden office with recessed glass, redwood sunshades, planted terraces and a carefully fitted stone base.

sight:bayview-common.name: Bayview Common
sight:bayview-common.description: A neighborhood common with shade trees, flower beds, cedar benches, a drinking fountain and paths linking all four sides.

sight:berkeley-esoteric.name: Berkeley Institute for Esoteric Studies
sight:berkeley-esoteric.description: Copper observatories, watchful stained glass, and an armillary instrument of uncertain purpose. A tiny Berkeley campus surrounds the institute: redwoods, a campanile, a colonnaded library, and scholars with impeccable credentials in impossible coincidences. Professor Vale can certify alien evidence.

sight:bicycle.name: Bicycle
sight:bicycle.description: A red city bicycle. Ride it along Market Street and through the park. Press B to ride or park it; dismount automatically at shop doors.

actor:golden-gate-park-bison.name: Bison
actor:golden-gate-park-bison.description: An enormous, shaggy park resident. The haircut is self-maintained.

sight:bolinas.name: Bolinas
sight:bolinas.description: Weathered cottages, a coastal grocer, and a village green among the Marin hills.

actor:bolinas-grocer.name: Bolinas Grocer
actor:bolinas-grocer.description: Knows a shortcut. Will probably describe it using a cafe that closed in 2018.

actor:bolinas-surfer.name: Bolinas Surfer
actor:bolinas-surfer.description: Appears to be mentally composing a strongly worded review of the weather.

sight:bottle-post-machine.name: Bottle-Post Conveyor
sight:bottle-post-machine.description: I never thought about how the technology worked.

actor:twitter-bottle-worker.name: Bottle-Post Engineer
actor:twitter-bottle-worker.description: A backend engineer with impeccable bottle discipline. Every cork is a deployment.

sight:house-search-7.name: Bread Box
sight:house-search-7.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:painted-bunny.name: Bunny
sight:painted-bunny.description: A very soft Alamo Square resident. Its entire calendar is reserved for snacks and head pats.

sight:academy.name: California Academy of Sciences
sight:academy.description: Rounded green hills form the living roof of the Academy. Skylights, gardens, and the Music Concourse make a small cultural center within the park.

sight:centeredness-institute.name: California Institute of Consciousness Research
sight:centeredness-institute.description: The California Institute of Consciousness Research. Celestial tiles and a copper observatory promise a rigorous measurement of the ineffable. Professor Meridian still needs a research assistant with a prehensile tail.

sight:center-research-institute.name: Californian Research Institute for Consciousness
sight:center-research-institute.description: The Californian Research Institute for Consciousness was the original institute's field station before the split. Star charts cover the glass roof, and the brass instruments are still calibrated to a different consensus reality.

sight:house-search-1.name: Cedar Chest
sight:house-search-1.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:house-search-3.name: Chest of Drawers
sight:house-search-3.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:chinatown.name: Chinatown
sight:chinatown.description: Red pillars, green roof tiles, and Grant Avenue leading into Chinatown. Keep heading north for City Lights.

sight:cityhall.name: City Hall
sight:cityhall.description: The granite wings and gilded dome of City Hall anchor Civic Center, just west of Market Street.

actor:city-hall-clerk.name: City Hall Clerk
actor:city-hall-clerk.description: An unflappable clerk. Her stamp has faced stranger paperwork than this.

place:writing.name: City Lights - Essays
place:writing.description: Pull up a chair. Essays on technology, markets, and the ideas that won't leave you alone.

sight:coit.name: Coit Tower
sight:coit.description: A pale tower above the steep streets of Telegraph Hill. North Beach sits just down the slope.

sight:conservatory.name: Conservatory of Flowers
sight:conservatory.description: A white glasshouse with a central dome, long glazed wings, and bright flower beds. The Panhandle begins a short ride to the east.

sight:cotogna.name: Cotogna
sight:cotogna.description: A brick neighborhood restaurant near Coit Tower. Neighbors eat at a table outside beneath the cotogna sign.

actor:cotogna-chef.name: Cotogna Chef
actor:cotogna-chef.description: An immaculate chef with a very tall hat and very exacting standards. Will accept a fish story, but only pays for the fish.

sight:lost-pirate-wreck.name: Crashed Pirate Ship
sight:lost-pirate-wreck.description: A tricorn-sized navigational error has become a full-sized shipwreck. The tide has claimed the stern; its captain is still disputing the insurance assessment.

sight:crissy.name: Crissy Field
sight:crissy.description: A low, open meadow beside the bay, below the wooded Presidio. Borrow the windsurf board by the promenade to sail off the beach.

sight:cupertino-orchard-gardens.name: Cupertino Orchard Gardens
sight:cupertino-orchard-gardens.description: Orchard paths, shaded benches and flowering gardens make a quiet circuit around the ring campus. Short courts lead home to low roofs and gardens.

place:etc.name: Curiosity Shop
place:etc.description: Other corners of the internet, a past life on the web, and a few digital novelties.

sight:southern-corner-123.name: Cypress Flowers
sight:southern-corner-123.description: These are for somebody, even if that somebody turns out to be you. The carefully kept storefront has a little terrace and a lived-in upper floor.

actor:southern-corner-123-neighbor.name: Cypress Flowers Shopkeeper
actor:southern-corner-123-neighbor.description: A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.

sight:deyoung.name: De Young Museum
sight:deyoung.description: A dark copper museum and a twisted observation tower overlook the Music Concourse. The Academy sits across the plaza.

sight:zoo-deer.name: Deer
sight:zoo-deer.description: The deer peacefully browses the grass. It has no plans to escape.

actor:lucindas-proprietor.name: Deli Proprietor
actor:lucindas-proprietor.description: A sandwich artisan whose delivery fleet fits inside the walk-in fridge. The flag is for morale.

actor:dog-pony-administrator.name: Dog and Pony Administrator
actor:dog-pony-administrator.description: A very small impresario with a clipboard, two exceptionally flexible employees, and complete confidence in the program.

sight:dog-pony-show.name: Dog and Pony Show
sight:dog-pony-show.description: A striped little showground beside Foundry Lane. The dog and pony have rehearsed exactly one trick, and are extremely proud of it.

sight:house-search-2.name: Dog House
sight:house-search-2.description: A man's best friend's favorite dwelling.

actor:pacifica-dog-surf-judge.name: Dog Surfing Judge
actor:pacifica-dog-surf-judge.description: The judge paces the beach in a yellow shirt, watching each dog from takeoff to landing.

sight:dolores.name: Dolores Park
sight:dolores.description: Palm trees and sloping lawns sit between the Mission and the Castro, with the downtown skyline beyond.

actor:noor-qualia.name: Dr. Noor Qualia
actor:noor-qualia.description: A phenomenologist whose lab notebook contains careful observations, many question marks, and one excellent soup recipe.

sight:duel-arena.name: Duel Arena
sight:duel-arena.description: A tiny garden arena, with room for two large financial opinions. Equal coin stakes, explicit agreement, and a fair 50-50 flip. Speak to the referee or challenge another player here.

actor:duel-referee.name: Duel Referee
actor:duel-referee.description: An impartial referee carrying one well-balanced coin and absolutely no spreadsheet for predicting which side it will land on.

actor:bolinas-emf-warrior.name: EMF Warrior
actor:bolinas-emf-warrior.description: He's grounding. He's earthing. He's got a thousand wires and a million volts running through him.

actor:esoteric-professor.name: Esoteric Researcher
actor:esoteric-professor.description: She has impeccable credentials in a field whose existence is fiercely disputed.

sight:fuel-outbound.name: Extortionate Gas Station
sight:fuel-outbound.description: The pump accepts every coin you have. The attendant calls this "market pricing."

actor:market-farmer-0.name: Farmer Ada
actor:market-farmer-0.description: A farmer in a black coat and tiny dark sunglasses. Can see through the simulation, but still insists on exact change for kale.

actor:market-farmer-1.name: Farmer Lin
actor:market-farmer-1.description: A farmer in a black coat and tiny dark sunglasses. Can see through the simulation, but still insists on exact change for kale.

actor:market-farmer-2.name: Farmer Null
actor:market-farmer-2.description: A farmer in a black coat and tiny dark sunglasses. Can see through the simulation, but still insists on exact change for kale.

actor:market-farmer-3.name: Farmer Root
actor:market-farmer-3.description: A farmer in a black coat and tiny dark sunglasses. Can see through the simulation, but still insists on exact change for kale.

sight:ferrari-car.name: Ferrari
sight:ferrari-car.description: It's very fast and can be yours for no money at all.

sight:ferrari-dealer.name: Ferrari Dealership
sight:ferrari-dealer.description: Fast, fashionable, and free. What a great promotion.

sight:ferry.name: Ferry Building
sight:ferry.description: The clock tower at the bay end of Market Street. Watch a streetcar roll past, then follow the waterfront north.

sight:wharf-fishing.name: Fishing Spot
sight:wharf-fishing.description: Small fish gather below the wharf, flickering beneath the surface.

sight:fuel-tahoe.name: Free Gondola Gas
sight:fuel-tahoe.description: Free fuel beside the Tahoe gondola. Fill the tank before driving back to San Francisco.

place:freemasons-guild.name: Freemasons' Guild
place:freemasons-guild.description: A sandstone lodge with a checkerboard floor, brass compasses and a landlord nobody discusses. Ray, in the red suit, handles admission.

actor:green-banker.name: Friendly Banker
actor:green-banker.description: A warm smile, a beautifully organized ledger, and a talent for remembering exactly how you take your coffee. Banking has rarely felt so hospitable.

actor:marin-bear.name: Friendly Bear
actor:marin-bear.description: A big bear with small ambitions: sunshine, a nap, and perhaps your sandwich.

actor:ferrari-dealer-attendant.name: Ferrari Lease Manager
actor:ferrari-dealer-attendant.description: A pump attendant with a tiny nozzle embroidered on their cap. Their smile depends entirely on how many coins you are carrying.

actor:fuel-outbound-attendant.name: Fuel Attendant
actor:fuel-outbound-attendant.description: A pump attendant with a tiny nozzle embroidered on their cap. Their smile depends entirely on how many coins you are carrying.

actor:fuel-return-attendant.name: Fuel Attendant
actor:fuel-return-attendant.description: A pump attendant with a tiny nozzle embroidered on their cap. Their smile depends entirely on how many coins you are carrying.

actor:fuel-tahoe-attendant.name: Fuel Attendant
actor:fuel-tahoe-attendant.description: A pump attendant with a tiny nozzle embroidered on their cap. Their smile depends entirely on how many coins you are carrying.

sight:country-bench-0.name: Garden Bench
sight:country-bench-0.description: A cedar bench, made for sitting a while. A very modest antidote to being in a hurry.

sight:zoo-giraffes.name: Giraffe
sight:zoo-giraffes.description: A giraffe surveys the city from an enviable height. Still cannot find affordable housing.

actor:tam-goblin-1.name: Goblin
actor:tam-goblin-1.description: A Mount Tam goblin in heavy boots. The morning fog followed him down from the mountain.

actor:tam-furniture-maker.name: Goblin Furniture Maker
actor:tam-furniture-maker.description: Mount Tam's most temperamental modernist. His ball chairs are round; his customer service is pointed.

sight:golden.name: Golden Gate Bridge
sight:golden.description: The orange towers span the Golden Gate between the Presidio and Marin. The Pacific opens to the west; the bay opens to the east.

sight:park.name: Golden Gate Park
sight:park.description: A long green escape on the western side of the city. Winding paths, cypress trees, and a pond full of very opinionated ducks.

sight:lore-explorable-home-7.name: Goose Corp Invoice
sight:lore-explorable-home-7.description: The rest of the invoice has been torn off.

sight:gpu-factory.name: GPU Factory
sight:gpu-factory.description: A South Bay chip factory with north-light roof bays, clean-room windows, cooling pipes, and a surprisingly enthusiastic raw-materials department.

actor:gpu-factory-buyer.name: GPU Factory Buyer
actor:gpu-factory-buyer.description: A clean-room procurement specialist. Has found a way to expense a trip to the beach.

actor:grain-merchant.name: Grain Merchant
actor:grain-merchant.description: A patient keeper of tiny sacks. Every duck in the park considers this person a major philanthropist.

place:green.name: Green Bank
place:green.description: A global financial institution for the people and agents of the future.

actor:haberdasher-merchant.name: Haberdasher
actor:haberdasher-merchant.description: A meticulous milliner who can estimate your net worth to the nearest brim. Considers a crown sensible everyday wear.

sight:haberdasher.name: Haberdashery
sight:haberdasher.description: A little hat shop just north of the GPU Factory, with recessed hat displays, a striped canopy, and a projecting top-hat sign.

sight:hiking-supplies.name: Hiker's Supplies
sight:hiking-supplies.description: The summit lift attendant rents skis for one coin. Then ski the winding course and jump its ramps.

actor:hiking-supplier.name: Hiking Supplies Clerk
actor:hiking-supplier.description: Carries a reusable bag with the quiet confidence of someone who remembered to bring it.

sight:times-square-works.name: Hillsborough Works
sight:times-square-works.description: Two lattice cranes lift the next chapter of the neighborhood. A small fenced digsite, a patient excavator, and Vic's clipboard keep the main square free for pedestrians.

place:explorable-home-1.name: House
place:explorable-home-1.description: A quiet home, keeping its own hours.

sight:whale-0.name: Humpback Whale
sight:whale-0.description: A humpback surfaces in the Pacific, followed by a silver plume of spray. Windsurf into position and jump over its back.

actor:tahoe-giant-1.name: Ice Giant
actor:tahoe-giant-1.description: A glacier has stood up, and it is not pleased about your carbon footprint.

sight:illuminati-stairway.name: Illuminati Passage
sight:illuminati-stairway.description: A discreet stairway carved beneath the lodge.

sight:in-n-out.name: In-N-Out
sight:in-n-out.description: A double-double beacon beyond the Bay Bridge. The palm trees have excellent taste in roadside stops.

actor:in-n-out-clerk.name: In-N-Out Associate
actor:in-n-out-clerk.description: Seems suspiciously well rested for someone living in a city with this much coffee.

place:home.name: John's Place
place:home.description: Are the renovations on this house finished? I'm not sure.

actor:square-busker.name: June
actor:square-busker.description: A street musician playing a song the zoning board has yet to approve.

sight:menottis-cafe.name: Menotti's
sight:menottis-cafe.description: The espresso machine is always busy, and regulars linger at the little pavement terrace.

actor:menottis-cafe-neighbor.name: Menotti's Barista
actor:menottis-cafe-neighbor.description: The barista keeps the espresso going and pays a coin for help clearing the tables.

sight:jurassic-biosciences.name: Jurassic Biosciences
sight:jurassic-biosciences.description: A gloriously indiscreet biosciences tower, topped by glass specimen lanterns, a DNA helix and some highly questionable scientific plumbing. A reinforced mesh enclosure stands outside.

actor:pacific-kraken.name: Kraken
actor:pacific-kraken.description: Goose Corp has persuaded him to take it easy on any adventurers.

sight:merced.name: Lake Merced
sight:merced.description: A freshwater lake near the southwestern edge of the city, south of the Sunset and close to the Pacific.

sight:house-search-4.name: Laundry basket
sight:house-search-4.description: I can't believe I'm going to search through this thing.

actor:square-bookseller.name: Leo, Bookseller
actor:square-bookseller.description: Purveyor of first editions of books that have not yet been written.

place:limit.name: Limit
place:limit.description: Selling tools that changed the daily lives of thousands of insurance professionals.

sight:beach-billboard.name: Local Minimum AI billboard
sight:beach-billboard.description: A Local Minimum AI advertisement promises a little gradient descent by the sea. Even the beach has a pitch deck.

actor:south-lost-goblin.name: Lost Goblin
actor:south-lost-goblin.description: A Mount Tam resident who took a wrong turn at the redwoods. He blames the trail signs.

actor:lost-pirate.name: Lost Pirate
actor:lost-pirate.description: He followed the treasure map exactly. Unfortunately, it was a restaurant menu.

sight:lucindas-deli.name: Lucinda's Deli
sight:lucindas-deli.description: A busy neighborhood deli with a well-used counter and the smell of freshly baked bread.

place:books.name: Main Library - Bookshelf
place:books.description: Fiction and non-fiction that stay with you, long after the last page.

sight:ducks.name: Ducks
sight:ducks.description: Mallards and little ducklings paddle around the pond. They seem certain you brought something for them.

sight:marin-bridge-landing.name: Marin Headlands Overlook
sight:marin-bridge-landing.description: Across the Golden Gate, the Marin hills look back over the orange towers and San Francisco.

actor:mazarine-clerk.name: Mazarine Clerk
actor:mazarine-clerk.description: Expert in brioche and soft-poached eggs.

place:links.name: Mazarine Coffee
place:links.description: The smoothest coffee on Market Street.

sight:lore-freemasons-guild.name: Minutes of the Lodge Committee
sight:lore-freemasons-guild.description: A red ledger records the lodge's more discreet arrangements.

actor:mira-softmax.name: Mira Softmax
actor:mira-softmax.description: A researcher carrying seven meditation timers, all confidently disagreeing about when the present begins.

actor:square-barista.name: Mira, Coffee Seller
actor:square-barista.description: A barista measuring the progress of the neighborhood in empty cups.

sight:zoo-motorcycle.name: Motorcycle
sight:zoo-motorcycle.description: A parked motorcycle with a gleaming tank and a neatly printed rental note: "5 coins."

actor:zoo-motorcycle-clerk.name: Motorcycle Rental Clerk
actor:zoo-motorcycle-clerk.description: A motorcycle rental clerk with a well-oiled keyring and a remarkably patient smile.

sight:mount-tam-goblins.name: Mount Tam Goblin Town
sight:mount-tam-goblins.description: A muddy path north of the jail leads to the Mount Tam goblins' settlement. Redwood offcuts, fog jars, and a furniture workshop have made the journey down the mountain.

sight:gondola-base.name: Mountain Gondola
sight:gondola-base.description: A gondola climbs the immense mountain above Lake Tahoe.

sight:southern-craft-1.name: Neighborhood Garden
sight:southern-craft-1.description: Herringbone paving, flowering pots, a cedar bench, and shade stitched together by the neighbors. A small but very good place to pause.

sight:nightlife.name: Nightlife
sight:nightlife.description: There's only one reason to be on this block, and it's to party.

sight:beach.name: Ocean Beach
sight:beach.description: The long Pacific shoreline beside the Great Highway. Golden Gate Park reaches the beach to the north, and the Sunset stretches inland.

sight:ocean-pocket-garden.name: Ocean Terrace Garden
sight:ocean-pocket-garden.description: A little neighborhood garden: flowering pots, a shaded bench, and a thoroughly unmonetized view.

actor:illuminati-old-man.name: Old Man
actor:illuminati-old-man.description: An Old Man with silver hair, a very discreet lapel pin, and a philanthropic interest in your coins.

sight:lore-explorable-home-1.name: On the Ownership of Ponds
sight:lore-explorable-home-1.description: A slim volume with a surprisingly extensive legal appendix.

sight:oracle.name: Oracle Park
sight:oracle.description: A brick ballpark opens toward McCovey Cove, with green grass, tiered stands, and tall floodlights above the waterfront.

sight:southern-village-gardens.name: Orchard and Foundry Gardens
sight:southern-village-gardens.description: Linked garden courts, tea tables, little bookshops and a birdwatching pergola link a quiet residential neighborhood to the foundry.

actor:tablet-wizard.name: Orin the Wizard
actor:tablet-wizard.description: Appears to be mentally composing a strongly worded review of the weather.

place:orin-house.name: Orin's house
place:orin-house.description: The noisy wizard inside is ruining the neighborhood character.

actor:south-grove-outlaw.name: Outlaw
actor:south-grove-outlaw.description: A woodland entrepreneur whose entire business model is your pockets.

sight:pacifica-park.name: Pacifica Commons
sight:pacifica-park.description: A neighborhood green with a fountain, shaded benches, and paths for a very unhurried lap. The ocean air is complimentary.

sight:pacifica-surf.name: Pacifica Surfboards
sight:pacifica-surf.description: Bright boards wait on the Pacifica beach. Paddle into the foam lines.

sight:painted.name: Painted Ladies
sight:painted.description: A row of colorful Victorian houses overlooking Alamo Square. A good place to pause before heading west to the park.

sight:palace.name: Palace of Fine Arts
sight:palace.description: A sandstone-colored rotunda rises beside a little lagoon. Its dome and colonnade mark the eastern edge of the Presidio and the Marina.

sight:southern-corner-129.name: Palmetto Pottery
sight:southern-corner-129.description: Every mug is a little different. The one with the wobble is about the nature of certainty.

sight:southern-corner-53.name: The Mill
sight:southern-corner-53.description: Local institution, recently relocated due to adverse events.

actor:southern-corner-129-neighbor.name: Palmetto Pottery Shopkeeper
actor:southern-corner-129-neighbor.description: It turns out that Palmetto Pottery is owned by the eponymous Palmetto.

actor:southern-corner-53-neighbor.name: Barista
actor:southern-corner-53-neighbor.description: Expert strategic deployer of beans toward hot water.

sight:windmill.name: Park Windmill
sight:windmill.description: A timber windmill and flower beds stand near the park's western end.

sight:zoo-penguins.name: Penguins
sight:zoo-penguins.description: A committee of penguins, formally dressed for a meeting about fish. The motion passes unanimously.

actor:police.name: Police
actor:police.description: An officer of the law. Their stamina appears to be funded in perpetuity.

actor:twitter-poster.name: Poster
actor:twitter-poster.description: He is staring deeply into his phone.

sight:presidio.name: Presidio - Main Post
sight:presidio.description: Wooded hills give way to a broad parade ground, a flagpole, and rows of red-roof barracks.

sight:airship.name: Private Jet Terminal
sight:airship.description: The private jet terminal occupies the building east of the runway. Its passenger entrance faces the airship mooring to the north.

actor:ada-meridian.name: Professor Ada Meridian
actor:ada-meridian.description: A director with a chalk-dusted coat and a compass that points toward the nearest open grant application.

actor:elias-index.name: Professor Elias Index
actor:elias-index.description: A professor with a very small ruler and an extraordinarily large jurisdictional dispute.

sight:prometheus.name: Prometheus
sight:prometheus.description: The Promethean spirit holds an eternal flame over the bay.

sight:qualia-bookshop.name: Qualia Books
sight:qualia-bookshop.description: A little bookshop beside the institutes. Its shelves run from practical gardening to deeply impractical theories of mind.

actor:qualia-bookshop-neighbor.name: Qualia Books Shopkeeper
actor:qualia-bookshop-neighbor.description: Strong opinions, loosely held, on things I don't understand.

actor:rail-lunch-worker.name: Rail Worker
actor:rail-lunch-worker.description: An excavator operator protecting a sandwich of considerable historical significance.

actor:guild-ray.name: Ray
actor:guild-ray.description: He says the red suit is only for special occasions. But every day is a special occasion.

actor:software-vendor.name: Seniormost Software Salesman
actor:software-vendor.description: A highly experienced man selling the software that sells the software. His business card has a business card.

sight:southern-lake-meadows.name: Redwood Lake and Meadows
sight:southern-lake-meadows.description: A wooded lake, open cow pasture, cottage gardens and colorful city flats along connected neighborhood lanes.

sight:redwood-office-court.name: Redwood Office Court
sight:redwood-office-court.description: A garden office with recessed glass, redwood sunshades, planted terraces and a carefully fitted stone base.

actor:rehabilitation-specialist.name: Rehabilitation Specialist
actor:rehabilitation-specialist.description: He has a spotless white coat, an immaculate bedside manner, and an enormous apparatus that has never once appeared in a medical textbook.

sight:rich-table.name: Rich Table
sight:rich-table.description: A little Hayes Valley house with a Rich Table sign. Neighbors share dinner at the tables outside.

actor:lucindas-deli-diner-0.name: Deli Patron
actor:lucindas-deli-diner-0.description: Contemplating a small plate with the seriousness usually reserved for a lunar landing.

actor:lucindas-deli-diner-1.name: Deli Patron
actor:lucindas-deli-diner-1.description: Contemplating a small plate with the seriousness usually reserved for a lunar landing.

actor:shanghai-kelly-diner-0.name: Barfly
actor:shanghai-kelly-diner-0.description: Contemplating a small plate with the seriousness usually reserved for a lunar landing.

actor:shanghai-kelly-diner-1.name: Bar Patron
actor:shanghai-kelly-diner-1.description: Contemplating a small plate with the seriousness usually reserved for a lunar landing.

actor:rich-table-diner-0.name: Rich Table Diner
actor:rich-table-diner-0.description: He says he is amused by the amuse bouche; surely the first person to ever make that joke.
